tasks.name: Basin egress
tasks.description: Leave a shallow terrain depression and settle beyond the rim.
tasks.source_task_or_operation: Leave a shallow terrain depression and settle beyond the rim.
tasks.applicability: Local anymal_c.xml has a free base and four three-joint legs with 12 position actuators. Foot contacts are the class=foot collision geoms in the four leg chains.  Task applicability is not a reachability or success claim.
tasks.adaptation: Adapt an abstract quadruped escape operation to the local morphology, without importing its robot or reward. Local proposed requirement, uncalibrated. The source supports the operation family only; this threshold, its time window and all scene dimensions below are not source success limits or demonstrated performance.
scene_assumptions: A rigid bowl-shaped heightfield has 0.20 m depth, 1.8 m rim radius and fixed small undulations, with level exterior ground.

The checked stock scene contains only the robot and a plane. Any fixtures, terrain, objects or scheduled events described here are requirements for a future task scene and are not supplied by this package. Robot morphology, actuators and collision geometry remain the canonical model.
observation_assumptions: Use MuJoCo state, forward kinematics, collision contacts and simulation time. Goals, routes and fixture state are declared task inputs; onboard perception or a navigation SDK is not assumed.

scoring.metric_definition: Minimum planar base distance from basin center in the final 2 s.
